_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for marketing meta. title = <=60 char (Google truncation). ogTitle = longer social/LLM version. NEVER swap them. Only the `home` entry is emitted to a real document today; the anchor entries (#tool, #pricing, #faq, ...) live here ready for a future route conversion — anchors currently inherit the homepage meta, which is correct. Validate with: node lib/seo/check-meta.js

pricing._pricingNote: Tier NAMES, not a universal USD price: India is charged INR (report ₹1,828 / monitor ₹4,715), US & rest-of-world USD ($19 / $49/mo). A '$19 & $49' title would be factually wrong for Indian traffic and cannot show two currencies in 60 chars, so we name the tiers instead. Offer schema (Step 4) carries both currencies.
